content.short: D2 Finance runs actively traded quantitative vaults with defined risk mandates.
content.description: D2 Finance operates quant strategies as on-chain vaults that are actively traded rather than passively allocated, deployed across several chains including Hyperliquid and Robinhood Chain. Active management on-chain gives depositors an unusual property compared with a traditional fund: they can watch every position in real time, for better or worse.
